summary: Defines several structured syntax suffixes for media type names, namely +json, +ber, +der, +fastinfoset, +wbxml and +zip. A suffix tells software the underlying format, so generic tools can handle specialized types. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A label like cake with chocolate shows what is inside. These endings tell a computer the basic kind of a file, even when the file has a fancy name.
